summary: Completed iteration 4 testing focused on CTA section redesign (old split red/navy layout replaced with parallax background image section). All 14 test cases passed at 100%. Verified both desktop (1920x800) and mobile (375x844) viewports. Regression tests for footer copyright bar and mobile navbar from iteration 3 also passed.

CTA section has parallax scroll effect on desktop (background-attachment: fixed)
CTA section on mobile (375px): background-attachment is scroll (no parallax)
CTA red label: 'ADMISSIONS OPEN 2025–26' text visible in red (rgb(192, 21, 42)), uppercase, centered
CTA heading: 'Ready to Join the Ananda Family?' in white (rgb(255, 255, 255)), bold, serif font (Playfair Display), centered
CTA subheading visible in white/80 opacity ('Begin your child's journey...'), centered
CTA buttons: 'Apply for 2025–26' (white bg rgb(255, 255, 255), navy text rgb(26, 46, 108)) and 'Download Brochure' (bordered white, white text) side by side on desktop (flexDirection: row)
CTA buttons on mobile (375px): stacked vertically (isStacked: true), full width (327px each)
CTA fade-in animations: elements have staggered animation classes (cta-stagger-1 through cta-stagger-4 all present)
Apply for 2025-26 button navigates to /admissions (href='/admissions', verified on both desktop and mobile)
Footer below CTA section is unchanged and intact
Mobile navbar (375px): 'Ananda Academy' text visible (regression test from iteration 3)
Footer copyright bar: Bomb Code Co. credit correctly shows 'Bomb Code Co.' with 36px logo (regression test from iteration 3)
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (existing from iteration 3): Console shows hydration warnings on Admissions page due to <span> wrappers inside <tbody>/<select>/<option> elements - doesn't affect UX but should be cleaned up in future
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified CTA section redesign: full-width parallax background image (desktop: background-attachment fixed, mobile: scroll), dark overlay rgba(10,20,60,0.72), red label 'ADMISSIONS OPEN 2025–26', white heading/subheading, staggered fade-in animations (cta-stagger-1 through cta-stagger-4), buttons side-by-side on desktop and stacked on mobile. Apply button navigates to /admissions. Footer unchanged. All 6 pages working. Hydration warnings on Admissions page still present (span wrappers in table/select elements).
